title: Live migration from any Kafka
tagline: Move onto the operator with zero downtime — from anywhere.
summary: Adopt brokers and controllers one at a time from a self-managed cluster, Strimzi, AWS MSK, or Confluent Cloud. The operator joins the existing quorum, mirrors topics in flight, then drains the source.
detail: Most teams never migrate Kafka clusters because the cutover is too risky. The operator's spec.adoptExistingCluster mode is designed to remove that risk: start the operator's brokers as additional voters against the source quorum (Kafka 3.9+ AddVoter/RemoveVoter API), let replication catch up, then remove the source brokers one-by-one. Clients keep talking to the same bootstrap throughout. No big-bang DNS flip, no MirrorMaker offset drift, no second cluster to maintain.

title: Tiered storage with Iceberg
tagline: Infinite retention, queryable as a data lake table.
summary: Offload cold log segments to S3 / Azure / GCS via Aiven's tiered storage plugin, with the cold tier readable as an Apache Iceberg table. Query historical Kafka with DuckDB, Trino, or Spark — no ETL pipeline.
detail: Brokers stay lean: hot data stays on the local volume, cold data lives in object storage. The same segments are also exposed as an Apache Iceberg table, so your data lake reads Kafka directly. Retention becomes effectively infinite at object-store prices, and the canonical archive is in a format every modern analytics engine already speaks. Configured under KafkaCluster.spec.storage.tiered; object-store credentials via Secret reference.

title: Streams topology designer
tagline: Drag Kafka Streams topologies on a canvas. Author schemas visually. Built on top of kafka-editor.
summary: A standalone React + Electron tool that extends the shipped kafka-editor SPA with a drag-on-canvas Kafka Streams topology editor, type-aware payload exploration via the schema registry, and visual schema authoring with reference resolution.
detail: kafka-editor already covers topic CRUD, produce, consumer-group reset, and schema-aware message browsing — see the editor feature page. The visual designer is the next layer: a drag-on-canvas topology editor that generates Kafka Streams DSL, deeper type-aware payload exploration, and visual schema authoring with reference resolution. Java backend for live cluster introspection; React + TypeScript + Vite frontend; packaged as both an Electron desktop app and an embeddable SPA that sits next to kafka-editor inside the operator-managed UI.
